definitions.gloss: to volunteer; to apply; to enlist
definitions.explanation: To offer oneself for a task, position, or service of one's own will. Often used for military enlistment or applying for a challenging role.

examples.japanese: ⟦{自|みずか}ら→自ら：00287_mizukara⟧{志願|しがん}した。
examples.english: He/she volunteered of their own accord.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{海外|かいがい}→海外：00134_kaigai⟧⟦{派遣|はけん}→派遣：13273_haken⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{志願|しがん}した。
⟦{危険|きけん}→危険：01141_kiken⟧な⟦{任務|にんむ}→任務：05513_ninmu⟧だった⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧、{多|おお}く⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{隊員|たいいん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{志願|しがん}して⟦{参加|さんか}した→参加する：25408_sankasuru⟧。
examples.english: It was a dangerous mission, but many members volunteered to participate.

notes:
{志願|しがん}する emphasizes acting of one's own will, especially for difficult or important tasks.

TRANSITIVITY:
- Type: ⟦{他動詞|たどうし}→他動詞：10418_tadoushi⟧ (transitive) / intransitive depending on use
- Pattern: [task/role]⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{志願|しがん}する or [task/role]⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{志願|しがん}する

FORMS:
{志|し} (will, aspiration) + {願|がん} (wish, desire)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{志願|しがん}→志願：12669_shigan⟧⟦{兵|へい}→兵：29510_hei⟧: volunteer soldier
- ⟦{志願|しがん}{者|しゃ}→志願者：20919_shigansha⟧: volunteer, applicant
- ⟦{自|みずか}ら→自ら：00287_mizukara⟧{志願|しがん}する: to volunteer of one's own accord

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{応募|おうぼ}→応募：03014_oubo⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to apply (general, for jobs/contests)
- {志願|しがん}する: to volunteer (emphasizes personal will, often for challenging roles)
- ⟦ボランティア→ボランティア：04834_borantia⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to volunteer (for community/charity work)
